verdict.rationale: A public roadmap is a fair ask for an open-source framework like Next.js. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a public roadmap or any published view of what the core team is working on. The docs cover framework features, migration guides and codemods; community comments discuss features, not a roadmap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public roadmap to see what the core team is currently working on
